messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without making unsupported claims?

## Short answer
To compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a Semiconductor competitor, the evidence must directly link the exact R&S VNA configuration, the exact competitor VNA configuration, the Semiconductor DUT/application, and the same measurement conditions; the current passages do not provide such a direct side-by-side comparison.[13][23][26][31][52]
## Required evidence
| Evidence required | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Exact R&S VNA model, options, and document version. | R&S VNA claims must be tied to specific product specifications, such as R&S ZNA models up to 67 GHz, ZNB3000 models up to 54.0 GHz with upgrades, or ZNA67EXT to 110 GHz.[57][80][85] | The passages provide R&S ZNA, ZNB3000, and ZNA67EXT product specifications and versions, but they do not compare them directly with a competitor for Semiconductor.[59][67][20] |
| Exact competitor VNA model, option codes, calibration accessories, and specification source. | The Keysight ENA/PNA passages list ENA/PNA only as platform names and do not provide concrete model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option, measurement accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth.[23][26] | A valid comparison needs Keysight official data or third-party verification, because the Keysight-related battle-card material says competitor descriptions need Keysight official or third-party validation.[31] |
| Direct Semiconductor application linkage. | A Semiconductor comparison needs evidence tying the VNA setup to a Semiconductor DUT or application, not just separate product specifications.[13][54] | The Samsung Semiconductor-related case is for 5G SoC including VCO and lists R&S FSWP50, R&S SMW200A, SGS100A, and competitor Keysight E5052B/VXG, but it is not a VNA comparison and lacks comparison data.[54][52] |
| Same measurement conditions for both sides. | R&S VNA specifications are condition-dependent, including temperature range, warm-up, calibration interval, measurement bandwidth, correction state, and calibration constraints.[9][19][70] | The competitor ENA/PNA passages do not provide matching test conditions, so side-by-side claims on accuracy, dynamic range, bandwidth, or speed would be unsupported.[23][26] |
| Side-by-side benchmark data under identical setup. | Dynamic range and other VNA metrics depend on conditions such as measurement bandwidth, user correction, port pairing, and calibration state.[16][70] | The available Keysight ENA/PNA sources provide no performance indicators, so they cannot support benchmark claims against R&S VNA specifications.[23][26] |
| Fixture, probe, de-embedding, and calibration method details. | Semiconductor or SoC-related probing/de-embedding cases depend on total solution elements such as probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, local partner, fixture, calibration, and method.[13][15][76] | Existing case passages explicitly state gaps such as DUT, frequency, fixture, calibration, topology, extender, probe, and de-embedding method not being fully specified.[13][76] |
| Source date, version, and authority for each side. | R&S sources identify specification document numbers, versions, and dates for ZNA, ZNB3000, and ZNA67EXT.[6][18][20] | The Keysight PCB solution image sources do not provide dates, document versions, product specifications, option codes, or prices.[31][34][44] |
| No market-share, customer-adoption, or “better than competitor” claim unless directly supported. | The Keysight PCB image source does not support product specifications, price, supply status, customer adoption, shipment volume, market share, or R&S relationship claims.[34] | The high-frequency PCB solution passages state the diagrams are process illustrations, not data charts, complete procurement lists, unique solutions, or AI server production-line adoption evidence.[39][44] |
## Minimum safe wording
The safe comparison can only say that R&S ZNA, ZNB3000, and ZNA67EXT have the cited R&S VNA specifications, while the current Keysight ENA/PNA passages only identify competitor platform names without enough model-level specifications for a technical comparison.[57][80][85][23][26]
Any claim that R&S is faster, more accurate, higher dynamic range, better for Semiconductor, or superior to Keysight would require a cited side-by-side source with exact R&S and Keysight configurations, Semiconductor DUT/application, and identical measurement conditions.[13][16][23][26][70]

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 與既有知識的關係
- 本來源補齊 [[R&S ZNA]] 主系列，與既有 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 形成關聯：[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System，量測範圍 10 MHz to 110 GHz；本來源的 [[R&S ZNA67]] 是 67 GHz base VNA 型號，並可透過 [[mmWave converter support]] 與 accessories 延伸應用。
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 spectrum / phase-noise analyzer 頁面在 [[Spectrum analyzer mode]]、[[Phase noise]]、[[Noise figure measurement]] 等功能上有橫向關聯，但本來源屬於 VNA 產品規格，不應與市場或技術背景合併。
- [[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS 與既有其他產品頁的 [[Health and utilization monitoring service]] 有橫向關聯；本來源列出 SNMP、REST JSON、SCPI、device web 等 readout/display protocols。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 原文未解的問題
- 來源有列出大量 options、accessories 與相依關係；本次 wiki 摘要保留主要可報價項目的 code、order no.、名稱與原文相依關係，但未逐字展開所有 calibration accessories、test cables、switch matrix extensions 的完整規格表。
- 部分表格同時出現 spec.、typ.、meas. 或 nom. 數值；本摘要依原文標示保留，不自行調和。
- 來源註明 Internal PC is subject to change without notice；因此 internal PC 規格需以此 Version 24.00（April 2026）為準。
- [[R&S ZNA-K121]] RF off boot up 在本次來源摘錄中列出名稱，但未提供 Order No.；頁面標示為來源未標示。
- 讀圖補充 p050 的尺寸數值旁單位無法辨識；不得推論為 mm 或其他單位。
- 本次輸入摘錄未提供讀圖頁面的圖片嵌入 wikilink，故 wiki 無法帶入原圖供核對。

R&S ZNA
[[R&S ZNA]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Network Analyzer 系列，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書涵蓋 [[R&S ZNA26]]、[[R&S ZNA43]]、[[R&S ZNA50]]、[[R&S ZNA67]]，頻率範圍從 10 MHz 延伸到最高 67 GHz。

R&S ZNA › R&S®ZNA-B15 RFFE GPIO interface 規格摘錄
- Models .02 and .03 提供 two independent MIPI RFFE busses。
- Connector type：25-pin D-Sub，female。
- RFFE port 1 / 2 的 VIO、DATA、CLK 電壓範圍為 0 V to +2 V，1 mV step，maximum current 20 mA。
- CLK configurable clock rate：31.25 kHz to 26 MHz。
- GPIO 1 to GPIO 8：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 20 mA。
- GPIO 9 and 10：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 100 mA。
- Model .03 提供 voltage and current measurement with switchable source resistance；32 internal ADC channels 可同時量測每個 RFFE 與 GPIO pin 的 voltage and current。

ZNB3000_specs_en_3647-5184-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後 warm-up operation 30 分鐘、符合 specified environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval，且已執行所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- 所有 specification data 在 **+18 °C to +28 °C** 有效；measurement accuracy 另要求 calibration 後 temperature variation 不得超過 **1 °C**，且 measurement 與 calibration 的 frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 必須相同，不允許 interpolation。
- Measurement range：impedance 50 Ω；frequency resolution 1 Hz；number of measurement points per trace 1 to 100001。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit **1 Hz to 1 MHz**；搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-K17]] 10 MHz receiver bandwidth option 時為 **1 Hz to 10 MHz**。
- 型號與頻率範圍：[[R&S ZNB3004]] 為 9 kHz to 4.5 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B082]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B084]] 可到 9.0 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3020]] 為 9 kHz to 20.0 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B262]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B264]] 可到 26.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3032]] 為 9 kHz to 32.0 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B442]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B444]] 可到 43.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3044]] 為 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B542]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B544]] 可到 54.0 GHz。
- Dynamic range 規格以 10 Hz measurement bandwidth、without user correction applied 為條件；使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range；crosstalk does not limit dynamic range。
- Measurement speed 以 firmware version 4.12 與 Windows 11 測得；來源註明 sweep time 應理解為 cycle time。
- General data：operating temperature +5 °C to +40 °C；storage temperature –20 °C to +60 °C；calibration interval 1 year；power supply 100 V to 240 V ±10 %，50 Hz to 60 Hz and 400 Hz，max. 3.5 A。
- Ordering information 列出 base units、frequency upgrade options、extended power range、receiver step attenuators、extended dynamic range、hardware options、software / measurement options、calibration accessories、power sensors、attenuators、switch matrices、test cables、hardware add-ons、warranty and service options。

ZNA67EXT_specs_en_5216-3743-22_v0900 › 與既有知識的關係

R&S ZNB3000 › Dynamic range 條件
- Receiver noise floor 定義為 transmission magnitude data trace 的 RMS 值，該 trace 由 noise 與 crosstalk 產生，test ports short-circuited。
- Specifications 適用於 10 Hz measurement bandwidth，without user correction applied。
- 使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range。
- Crosstalk does not limit dynamic range。
- Dynamic range performance 規格化於 port 1 與 port 2 之間，以及 4-port model 的 port 3 與 port 4 之間；其他 dynamic range performance 為 typical。
- Without enhanced dynamic range mode 時，above 100 kHz 的 nominal system dynamic range 會降低 15 dB to 20 dB；below 100 kHz 的影響可能更高。

- Optional rear panel LO out 可支援 mmWave converters；4-port model 最多 4 個 converters，2-port model 最多 2 個 converters，無需 external signal generator；rear panel LO out typ. +25 dBm，最高 26.5 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA-K28]] continuous data recording 支援 infinite data point capture、circular buffer，並可透過 LAN 或 USB 連續資料傳輸。
- [[R&S ZNA-B26]] direct IF access：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。

## Short answer
To compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a Semiconductor competitor, the evidence must directly link the exact R&S VNA configuration, the exact competitor VNA configuration, the Semiconductor DUT/application, and the same measurement conditions; the current passages do not provide such a direct side-by-side comparison.[13][23][26][31][52]
## Required evidence
| Evidence required | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Exact R&S VNA model, options, and document version. | R&S VNA claims must be tied to specific product specifications, such as R&S ZNA models up to 67 GHz, ZNB3000 models up to 54.0 GHz with upgrades, or ZNA67EXT to 110 GHz.[57][80][85] | The passages provide R&S ZNA, ZNB3000, and ZNA67EXT product specifications and versions, but they do not compare them directly with a competitor for Semiconductor.[59][67][20] |
| Exact competitor VNA model, option codes, calibration accessories, and specification source. | The Keysight ENA/PNA passages list ENA/PNA only as platform names and do not provide concrete model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option, measurement accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth.[23][26] | A valid comparison needs Keysight official data or third-party verification, because the Keysight-related battle-card material says competitor descriptions need Keysight official or third-party validation.[31] |
| Direct Semiconductor application linkage. | A Semiconductor comparison needs evidence tying the VNA setup to a Semiconductor DUT or application, not just separate product specifications.[13][54] | The Samsung Semiconductor-related case is for 5G SoC including VCO and lists R&S FSWP50, R&S SMW200A, SGS100A, and competitor Keysight E5052B/VXG, but it is not a VNA comparison and lacks comparison data.[54][52] |
| Same measurement conditions for both sides. | R&S VNA specifications are condition-dependent, including temperature range, warm-up, calibration interval, measurement bandwidth, correction state, and calibration constraints.[9][19][70] | The competitor ENA/PNA passages do not provide matching test conditions, so side-by-side claims on accuracy, dynamic range, bandwidth, or speed would be unsupported.[23][26] |
| Side-by-side benchmark data under identical setup. | Dynamic range and other VNA metrics depend on conditions such as measurement bandwidth, user correction, port pairing, and calibration state.[16][70] | The available Keysight ENA/PNA sources provide no performance indicators, so they cannot support benchmark claims against R&S VNA specifications.[23][26] |
| Fixture, probe, de-embedding, and calibration method details. | Semiconductor or SoC-related probing/de-embedding cases depend on total solution elements such as probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, local partner, fixture, calibration, and method.[13][15][76] | Existing case passages explicitly state gaps such as DUT, frequency, fixture, calibration, topology, extender, probe, and de-embedding method not being fully specified.[13][76] |
| Source date, version, and authority for each side. | R&S sources identify specification document numbers, versions, and dates for ZNA, ZNB3000, and ZNA67EXT.[6][18][20] | The Keysight PCB solution image sources do not provide dates, document versions, product specifications, option codes, or prices.[31][34][44] |
| No market-share, customer-adoption, or “better than competitor” claim unless directly supported. | The Keysight PCB image source does not support product specifications, price, supply status, customer adoption, shipment volume, market share, or R&S relationship claims.[34] | The high-frequency PCB solution passages state the diagrams are process illustrations, not data charts, complete procurement lists, unique solutions, or AI server production-line adoption evidence.[39][44] |
## Minimum safe wording
The safe comparison can only say that R&S ZNA, ZNB3000, and ZNA67EXT have the cited R&S VNA specifications, while the current Keysight ENA/PNA passages only identify competitor platform names without enough model-level specifications for a technical comparison.[57][80][85][23][26]
Any claim that R&S is faster, more accurate, higher dynamic range, better for Semiconductor, or superior to Keysight would require a cited side-by-side source with exact R&S and Keysight configurations, Semiconductor DUT/application, and identical measurement conditions.[13][16][23][26][70]

Effective system data 條件：valid between **+18 °C and +28 °C**，temperature after calibration varied by no more than **1 °C**；frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 必須與 calibration identical，no interpolation；measurement bandwidth **10 Hz**，nominal source power **–10 dBm**；calibration kit 為 [[R&S ZN-Z210]]。

Test port input noise 條件：**1 kHz measurement bandwidth, normalized to 1 Hz**。來源 footnote 5 說 different bandwidth add `[10 × log10(bandwidth / 1Hz)]` to the given noise level。
